items.text: Never have I ever pretended to be asleep to avoid someone
Never have I ever pretended to be sick to skip something
Never have I ever read someone else's diary
Never have I ever stalked an ex's social media for hours
Never have I ever said I was fine when I was not
Never have I ever cried alone in a supermarket
Never have I ever been jealous of someone else's life
Never have I ever lost a friend without knowing why
Never have I ever cheated at a game I was losing
Never have I ever felt lonely at a party full of people
Never have I ever kept a secret that hurt someone
Never have I ever broken up with someone over text
Never have I ever pretended to like a gift
Never have I ever regretted a tattoo
Never have I ever made a wish I am ashamed of
Never have I ever googled someone I dated
Never have I ever stolen something small and felt guilty
Never have I ever ignored my parents' calls for a whole week
Never have I ever hidden a bad grade or a bill from someone
Never have I ever fallen out with a sibling for years
Never have I ever pretended to be someone else online
Never have I ever missed a family event because I was too tired
Never have I ever wished a stranger bad luck
Never have I ever sworn at a teacher
Never have I ever ghosted a recruiter
Never have I ever felt relieved when a plan got cancelled
Never have I ever kept a list of people who hurt me
Never have I ever reread the last message from someone I lost
Never have I ever been the person everyone talks about behind their back
Never have I ever lied to a doctor about my habits
Never have I ever spent more than I earned in a month
Never have I ever been given the silent treatment for a whole day
Never have I ever felt I did not belong in my own family
Never have I ever deleted a photo I wish I had kept
Never have I ever gone back to an ex I knew was bad for me
Never have I ever believed a rumour about myself
Never have I ever lied about where I was last night
Never have I ever been caught in a lie I had told for years
Never have I ever cried in a bathroom at work
Never have I ever faked a laugh at a joke I did not get
Never have I ever broken a promise I made to myself
Never have I ever kept a bad friend because I was afraid to be alone
Never have I ever written something online I wish I could delete
Never have I ever started a fight in a public place
Never have I ever avoided a friend's call for months
